EC1: Patients with liver cirrhosis [OR], Hepatocellular Carcinoma [OR] or AFP [OR] >2 ULN or other malignancies.
EC2: Patients with other factors causing liver diseases.
EC4: Patients with concomitant HIV infection [OR] or congenital immune deficiency diseases.
EC7: Patients with serious complications (e.g., infection [OR], hepatic encephalopathy [OR], hepatorenal syndrome [OR], gastrointestinal bleeding.)
EC8: Patients who receive antineoplastic [OR] or immunomodulatory therapy in the past 12 months.
EC9: Patients with a previous use of IFN [OR] anti hepatitis B virus treatment or have NAs drug [AND] resistance.
EC10: Patients who can't come back to clinic for follow-up on schedule.
